assumptions.choice: Applied the Close > SMA(200) uptrend condition to the entry (buy) signal only, not to the exit (sell) signal.
assumptions.reason: The spec states 'trade only in a long-term uptrend' immediately before the buy conditions, then describes the sell conditions as a fully self-contained euphoria/calm test; read as an entry filter for the panic-buy pattern rather than a gate on closing an already-open position, since the spec explicitly rules out stop-losses as the only other exit mechanism.

assumptions.choice: Used order_target_percent(target=1.0) to enter (allocating 100% of portfolio value) and self.close() to exit.
assumptions.reason: Spec explicitly states position size is fixed at 100% of capital, so the canonical default of plain buy()/sell() with no size argument does not apply; order_target_percent is the standard backtrader idiom for full-capital sizing, while close() follows the canonical default for exits.

assumptions.choice: Used backtrader's default bt.indicators.RSI(period=14), which internally applies Wilder's smoothed moving average.
assumptions.reason: Spec names 'RSI(14)' without specifying a smoothing variant; backtrader's default RSI implementation is the standard Wilder RSI.

assumptions.choice: Computed width as the line-wise difference bb.lines.top - bb.lines.bot, then applied SMA(period=50) to that difference series.
assumptions.reason: Spec defines width explicitly as (upper-lower); this is the literal computation, implemented via backtrader's native line arithmetic so it updates each bar like any other indicator.
